alerts.title: Viral load monitoring overdue
alerts.message: Guidelines state that patients on DTG-based first-line ART should have VL checked every 6 months, and if VL < 50 copies/mL for >1 year with reliable adherence, monitoring can be reduced to 12 monthly. Patient's last VL was 20 copies/mL on 2025-09-15, 129 days ago. The prior VL was 30 copies/mL on 2024-09-15. Both were suppressed. With two consecutive suppressed VLs spanning over a year and good adherence, the patient qualifies for 12-monthly VL monitoring, so the next VL would be due around 2026-09-15. No VL is currently overdue.

evidence.recommended_action: No VL currently due. Schedule next VL around September 2026 per 12-monthly interval for stable suppressed patients.
